notes.title: Chinese update
notes.content:
Hi, this is CreaTeam.

We noticed that our game has been crashing in China for the last week, so as a token of our gratitude we made an update with a normal, non-machine translation into Chinese.

Enjoy your poop!

notes.title: TOTAL CONVERSION!!!
notes.content:
Hey. You didn't ask for it, but we still delivered. Meet the update to the funniest game of 2018.

[list]
[*] 14 new languages have been added, including German, French, Italian, Korean, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese, Polish, Dutch, Swedish, Czech, Turkish and sign language (ok, that last one is obviously a lie).

[*] A leaderboard has been added so that you can show off to your friends, just watch out for them, don't let them beat your ass or put you in an Asylum or something.

[*] Well, and also, most of the bugs have been fixed, achievements have been completely reworked and new scenes have been added.
[/list]

You can even say that this is a remastered version, but for which you don't have to pay again.
Enjoy it!
